name: Momin Mohammed Arfat Portfolio Agent

skills.name: Query Developer Profile

skills.name: List Portfolio Projects
skills.description: Discover full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms, and AI engineering projects built by Arfat, with repository links and live URLs.
examples: What web applications has Arfat built?
List all featured portfolio projects and their tech stacks.

skills.name: Query Technical Skills
skills.description: Query technical proficiencies across frontend, backend, databases, AI/LLM integrations, and DevOps.
examples: What technologies does Arfat work with?
Does Arfat have experience with Next.js and PostgreSQL?

examples: How can I get in touch with Arfat?
